content: Both #38319 and #38140 "golf" proofs by changing them to rfl. I suspect both introduce some defeq abuse. Do we have tooling to help us detect make this precise?
(In the long run, using the module system more to make more definitions un-exposed will help. But we're not there yet.)
well I can't see how #38140 is defeq abuse, since the theorem is right after the definitions and it's a relatively obvious definitional equality
I can see how that could be considered defeq abuse
I'm also happy if you vouch for a PR and maintainer merge it :-)

I think #38140 is definitely no def-eq abuse, but it also not an improvement, so I vote for closing it.
For #38139 I agree that the new proof is worse, so I would also vote for closing it.
I think #38140 is an improvement: I wonder if the old proof was from Lean 3 when eta on structures wasn't a defeq. The new proof also allows dsimp to work on this equality
